BoardRead.title: BoardRead
BoardRead.description: One explicit read-marking batch. ``post_ids`` is capped at 100.

BridgeTrigger.title: BridgeTrigger
BridgeTrigger.description: Typed operator trigger: names a target only; evidence is always re-fetched.

ConversationReconcile.title: ConversationReconcile
ConversationReconcile.description: Optional revision fence for a reconcile scan; omitted means scan without writing.

ConversationReply.title: ConversationReply
ConversationReply.description: Answer recorded by the request's addressee, sent through existing reply validation.

ConversationRequestCreate.title: ConversationRequestCreate
ConversationRequestCreate.description: Tracked request/reply workflow. The message itself uses the existing send validation.

CredentialConfirmation.title: CredentialConfirmation
CredentialConfirmation.description: Explicit operator confirmation bound to a freshly reviewed impact.

ExploreBody.title: ExploreBody
ExploreBody.description:
One explicit context-exploration request. ``project_id`` comes from the path,
never the body, so a body cannot retarget another project.

ExportCreate.title: ExportCreate
ExportCreate.description: Explicit reviewed confirmation binds the export to this exact project.

GoalRevise.title: GoalRevise
GoalRevise.description:
Replace the current plan with a new immutable revision.

At most one explicit source: ``steps`` (supplied), ``statement`` (extractive),
or ``intent_id`` (durable provider intent in ``done`` state). With none, the
revision carries over the not-yet-completed tasks of the current plan.

HandoffAccept.title: HandoffAccept
HandoffAccept.description: Recipient decision fence: exact offer revision plus the exact current run.

HandoffDeliverable.title: HandoffDeliverable
HandoffDeliverable.description: A typed deliverable reference at an exact revision; content is never inlined.

HandoffOffer.title: HandoffOffer
HandoffOffer.description: Canonical handoff proposal bound to the exact sender execution snapshot.

HoldResolution.title: HoldResolution
HoldResolution.description:
Operator decision for a ``manual_hold`` coordination action.

``dismiss`` and ``escalate`` never alter ownership. ``reassign`` and
``dead_letter`` require the execution to be absent or canonically settled;
``acknowledge_unknown_effects`` is recorded for audit but is NOT evidence and
never bypasses that requirement.

LeaseRenewal.title: LeaseRenewal
LeaseRenewal.description: Fenced request to extend one live delivery lease. It never starts a new attempt.

PinnedRef.title: PinnedRef
PinnedRef.description: A source context reference pinned to an exact current revision.

PolicyTick.title: PolicyTick
PolicyTick.description: One bounded evaluation pass. Non-admin callers must fence with the Nexus lease.

PolicyUpdate.title: PolicyUpdate
PolicyUpdate.description:
Opt-in, typed, bounded per-project coordination policy.

Every field has hard bounds so a policy can never request unbounded retries,
unbounded scans, or zero-cost automation. Defaults are the safest posture:
disabled, no automatic reassignment, no automatic dead-lettering, and a required
coordinator lease for non-admin ticks.

ReportedTest.title: ReportedTest
ReportedTest.description: Producer-reported test outcome. Never treated as objective proof.

ResourceDeclaration.title: ResourceDeclaration
ResourceDeclaration.description:
Explicit effect declaration for one task, scoped to the task's project.

``reads``/``writes`` hold normalized ``scope:``, ``path:``, ``artifact:``,
``dependency:``, or ``interface:`` keys. Keys referencing real resources are
authorized at declaration time. ``interfaces``/``dependencies`` are treated as
shared writes for conflict purposes. A key may not be both read and written.
Declarations freeze while an execution exists for the task.

RoutingDispatch.title: RoutingDispatch
RoutingDispatch.description: Nexus-fenced durable approval of one exact (task, agent, run) pair.

RoutingQuery.title: RoutingQuery
RoutingQuery.description: Advisory routing query. A query grant is never dispatch authority.

RunTaskContext.title: RunTaskContext
RunTaskContext.description: Worker consumption fence: the exact current run, task, execution, revision.

RuntimeDeclaration.title: RuntimeDeclaration
RuntimeDeclaration.description:
Authorized per-agent runtime/tool declaration; names are registry-approved.

The flags are advisory intent, never proof: strict-sandbox eligibility
additionally requires the operator's run-bound verifier at route time.
``expected_revision`` is an optional CAS fence; declarations freeze while
the agent has in-flight bound work.

SearchPageBody.title: SearchPageBody
SearchPageBody.description:
``search_page`` request. Scan policy is operator-fixed by ``install``; clients
